entries.title: Psalms 145:1
segments: Praise. Of David. I will lift You up, my God, O King; and I will bless Your name forever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 145:2
segments: Every day I will bless You; and I will praise Your name forever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 145:3
segments: Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and [there is] no searching out His greatness.

entries.title: Psalms 145:4
segments: One generation shall praise Your works to another, and shall declare Your mighty acts.

entries.title: Psalms 145:5
segments: I will speak of the glorious honor of Your majesty, and of Your wonderful works.

entries.title: Psalms 145:6
segments: And [men] shall speak of the might of Your awesome works; and I will declare Your greatness.

entries.title: Psalms 145:7
segments: They shall pour forth the memory of Your great goodness, and shall sing of Your righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 145:8
segments: The LORD [is] gracious and full of pity; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 145:9
segments: The LORD [is] good to all; and His tender mercies [are] over all His works.

entries.title: Psalms 145:10
segments: All Your works shall praise You, O LORD; and Your saints shall bless You.

entries.title: Psalms 145:11
segments: They shall speak of the glory of Your kingdom and talk of Your power,

entries.title: Psalms 145:12
segments: to make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, and the glorious majesty of His kingdom.

entries.title: Psalms 145:13
segments: Your kingdom [is] an everlasting kingdom, and Your rule [endures] throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 145:14
segments: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all [those] bowed down.

entries.title: Psalms 145:15
segments: The eyes of all wait on You; and You give them their food in due season.

entries.title: Psalms 145:16
segments: [You] open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

entries.title: Psalms 145:17
segments: The LORD [is] righteous in all His ways and holy in all His works.

entries.title: Psalms 145:18
segments: The LORD [is] near all those who call on Him, all those who call on Him in truth.

entries.title: Psalms 145:19
segments: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear Him; He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

entries.title: Psalms 145:20
segments: The LORD watches over all those who love Him; but all the wicked He will destroy.

entries.title: Psalms 145:21
segments: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD; and let all flesh bless His holy name forever and ever.
